title: TRIVING SUN WORLD VISION – 21/06/2026
summary: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the Chi Women's Society of the 29th Street, Long Ping, the Plains of Nai during the tour, play and mate at Sun World War China.

content.text: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the Chi Women's Society of the 29th Street, Long Ping, the Plains of Nai during the tour, play and mate at Sun World War China.

The trip was a time for girls, sisters to relax, stick together, and create happy moments, meanings, family and friends. Thank you the Women's Association of District 29 for trusting TodayTourist selection for this journey.
In particular, I'd like to thank HDV Dao for his warm and supportive cooperation and bringing a cheerful, thoughtful show to the crew.
